tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Brand primary (Díade deep teal). The left D of the mark, the app-icon ground, splash screens and marketing. 9.4:1 on white. In the UI reach for `action` instead; never use it as text or a fill on the dark theme's grounds (1.9:1 on `bg` dark).

tokens.name: brand-mint
tokens.usage: Brand secondary. The right D of the mark, illustrations and large decorative fills. Only 2.1:1 on white: never text, icons, control borders or focus rings on light grounds. Text on it is `brand-deep` (4.6:1). Doubles as `action` in the dark theme.

tokens.name: brand-mist
tokens.usage: Brand accent. Soft highlights, selected chips and the light `action-soft` fill. Decorative only on white (1.4:1); text on it is `brand-deep` (6.6:1).

tokens.name: brand-overlap
tokens.usage: The shared region where the mark's two Ds overlap. Logo artwork and illustrations only; not a UI colour.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: Fill of the mark's left D and of the wordmark: deep teal in light, white in dark, so the logo reads on both `bg` values.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Main app/page background (the brief's Background #F7FAF9). Screens, the web canvas.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, list groups, nav rail (the brief's Surface #FFFFFF in light).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: search fields, segmented-control track, empty states.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Mint wash for shared things: the shared-space banner, selected nav item, shared badges. Text on it is `ink`, `ink-muted` or `on-action-soft`. Never the only sign of a selected state: it is under 3:1 against `surface`, so pair it with the `action` indicator.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines that carry no meaning (decorative, below 3:1 by design).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control: inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons. 3.3:1 on `bg`, 3.5:1 on `surface` light; 4.1/3.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`, `surface-tint`, `action-soft`, `personal-soft` (≥11.8:1 light, ≥8.5:1 dark). Replaces the brief's #0F172A with a teal-tinted near-black of the same strength.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, timestamps, helper text, inactive nav labels. On `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`, `surface-tint` (≥5.6:1 light, ≥6.6:1 dark). Replaces the brief's #64748B, which fell to 4.2:1 on the mint tint. Also input placeholders and helper text.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Labels of disabled controls only (WCAG 1.4.3 exempts inactive components). Never for placeholders, hints or anything a person must read: those use `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary action fill: the main button, toggles on, progress, the checked checkbox. Deep teal in light, mint in dark. Also the selected-state indicator in nav (bar) and tab bars (pill), which must clear 3:1 against its ground (8.2:1 light, 6.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of `action` (web, pointer devices).

tokens.name: action-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of `action` (all platforms).

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `action`, `action-hover`, `action-pressed` (≥9.4:1 light, ≥6.4:1 dark). Never hard-code white: it is dark teal in the dark theme.

tokens.name: action-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary/tonal button fill and selected chips (brief's Accent in light).

tokens.name: on-action-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `action-soft` and `surface-tint`.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-tint`; always underlined in running text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard/switch focus: a solid 2px ring with a 2px `bg` gap. ≥6.2:1 on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: personal-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for personal (not shared) items: the Personal badge, private notes. Warm sand so personal reads differently from the mint shared tint in lightness and hue — always with the lock icon and the word.

tokens.name: on-personal
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `personal-soft` (6.9:1 light, 10.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Synced / done text and icon on `success-soft`, `surface`, `bg`. Always with an icon and a word: it matches `danger` in lightness.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success notices and the Synced state.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending / attention text and icon on `warning-soft`, `surface`, `bg`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warnings and the Pending state.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, sync conflicts, destructive actions; text and icon on `danger-soft`, `surface`, `bg`. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for errors and the Conflict state.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information text and icon on `info-soft`, `surface`, `bg`.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for informational notices.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the home greeting, onboarding, empty-state headlines.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Screen titles (iOS large title, Android top app bar large).

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles, event titles in detail views.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick up the keys from the porter before 6.
styles.usage: Default reading text, list item titles, inputs. Never smaller for content.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body, list item titles that need weight.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines: metadata, helper text, list subtitles. Usually in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, tab-bar labels, counters. Never for sentences.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in badges; hairline nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles and list items; badge horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin on phones; card padding; default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Tile padding; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing on phones; card padding on web; screen margin on tablets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing on web; screen margin on desktop web.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small chips inside cards, inputs' inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, list rows in a group, nav items, icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dashboard tiles, banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, modals, the web app's main panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons (pills), badges, avatars, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards and tiles on `bg`.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Raised: menus, popovers, the floating add button.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets and modals.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable on both platforms (Android 48dp; clears iOS 44pt).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of default buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of compact buttons and chips (keep a 48px hit area around them).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges and captions.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, nav items and list rows.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Tab bar, toolbar and tile icons.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Each avatar in the AvatarPair header.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (with `ink-disabled` labels where text matters).
